name: Flind
heading: Flinds as Characters
distinction: Gnoll lineage. Use the Flinds as Characters rules, including two racial Hit Dice and LA +2.

name: Forestkith Goblin
heading: Forestkith Goblins as Characters
distinction: Goblin lineage. The player traits list Climb bonuses but no climb speed or natural bite. The example uses this narrower reading. The p. 65 errata revises published sample stats.

name: Poison Dusk Lizardfolk
heading: Poison Dusk as Characters
distinction: Lizardfolk lineage using the distinct Poison Dusk player profile. The p. 97 official errata revises both sample blocks without changing the player traits.

name: Viletooth Lizardfolk
heading: Viletooth Lizardfolk
distinction: Lizardfolk lineage using all base 3.5 player traits except the changes on Dragon Magic p. 9. The Poison Dusk player profile is separate.

name: Sunscorch Hobgoblin
heading: Sunscorch Hobgoblins
distinction: Hobgoblin lineage. Apply only the Dragon Magic substitutions over the 3.5 core hobgoblin.
